Definition
[Asymptotic volume ratio] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0038 1. ch27:eq-27.69\group Volume growth

When the limit exists, \[ \operatorname {AVR}(g)=\lim _{r\to \infty } \frac{\operatorname {Vol}B_O(r)}{\omega _nr^n}. \] For nonnegative Ricci curvature it exists in $[0,1]$ and is base-point independent.
